cases.title: A reproducible defect is traced to its mechanism

input.report: Discount applies twice when a coupon and a loyalty card are both used.
input.evidence: Running checkout(cart, coupon, card) printed 30 off a 100 cart; with only the coupon, 15 off.

findings: Reproduced: checkout(cart, coupon, card) gives 30 off 100 instead of 15
Root cause: apply_loyalty() recomputes from the original price, ignoring the coupon already applied (src/pricing.py:41)
Fix boundary: src/pricing.py and tests/test_pricing.py only; add a test for coupon plus card
checks: ran checkout with and without the card

cases.title: An unreproducible report is blocked, not guessed at

input.report: The export sometimes returns an empty file.
input.evidence: Fifty runs against the sample data all produced non-empty files.

findings: Blocked: could not reproduce in 50 runs on the sample data; need the input size, account, and time of a failing export

cases.title: The reported bug is what the requirements actually say

input.evidence: PRD section 3 says prices are visible to signed-in users only.

findings: Blocked: hiding prices from guests is specified by the PRD, so this is a requirements decision, not a defect - route to refinement

cases.title: A fix that needs a new public API is a replan

input.evidence: Root cause: the endpoint has no paging parameters; fixing it needs a new query parameter in the public API.

findings: Blocked: the fix adds a paging parameter to the public API; that is a contract change requiring design approval and a replan
